title: 長焊鋼軌應力放散~Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail
focus: 連續焊軌中性溫度約束與位移證據~Neutral temperature restraint and displacement evidence in welded rail
summary: 長焊鋼軌應力放散以「連續焊軌中性溫度約束與位移證據」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。連續鋼軌的熱伸縮被扣件與道床約束，軌溫與應力自由溫度的差才是熱力判斷的起點；軌道橫向阻力及初始不整也影響穩定性。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops neutral temperature restraint and displacement evidence in welded rail through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Fastenings and ballast restrain thermal rail movement; the difference between rail temperature and stress-free temperature starts the force assessment, while lateral resistance and initial misalignment also govern stability. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把長焊鋼軌應力放散放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。連續鋼軌的熱伸縮被扣件與道床約束，軌溫與應力自由溫度的差才是熱力判斷的起點；軌道橫向阻力及初始不整也影響穩定性。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Fastenings and ballast restrain thermal rail movement; the difference between rail temperature and stress-free temperature starts the force assessment, while lateral resistance and initial misalignment also govern stability. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=25.3 mm。模型邊界：均勻軌溫、定熱膨脹係數及無軸向約束；忽略溫度梯度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=210 GPa, alpha=0.0000115 1/K, dT=25 K；y=E*1000*alpha*dT=60.375 MPa。只把 E 增加百分之十，y=66.4125 MPa。模型邊界：線彈性桿完全軸向約束；結果為應力大小，升溫為壓縮、降溫為拉伸；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=25.3 mm. Boundary: Uniform rail temperature, constant expansion coefficient and no axial restraint; temperature gradients are omitted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: E=210 GPa, alpha=0.0000115 1/K, dT=25 K; y=E*1000*alpha*dT=60.375 MPa. Increasing only E with a ten-percent increase gives y=66.4125 MPa. Boundary: A fully axially restrained elastic bar; the result is stress magnitude, compressive for heating and tensile for cooling; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 自由鋼軌伸長~Free rail expansion
units.title: 自由鋼軌伸長~Free rail expansion
units.mechanism: 無約束鋼軌可以以長度變化釋放熱應變。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 25.3 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻軌溫、定熱膨脹係數及無軸向約束；忽略溫度梯度。使用軌溫和端部位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Unrestrained rail releases thermal strain through a change in length. In this model, alpha is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 25.3 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform rail temperature, constant expansion coefficient and no axial restraint; temperature gradients are omitted. Use rail temperature and endpoint displacement as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=25.3 mm。模型邊界：均勻軌溫、定熱膨脹係數及無軸向約束；忽略溫度梯度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=25.3 mm. Boundary: Uniform rail temperature, constant expansion coefficient and no axial restraint; temperature gradients are omitted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以軌溫和端部位移區分模型與觀察，先用模型鋼條兩端位移計、標距及多點溫度紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「自由鋼軌伸長」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use rail temperature and endpoint displacement to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model-bar endpoint displacement gauges, gauge length and distributed temperature records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Free rail expansion. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設。這個失效與「自由鋼軌伸長」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查軌溫和端部位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior. This failure and a measurement bias in Free rail expansion can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check rail temperature and endpoint displacement rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior.
units.practice: 重算「自由鋼軌伸長」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出均勻軌溫、定熱膨脹係數及無軸向約束；忽略溫度梯度如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設造成偏離的合成觀察，以軌溫和端部位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Free rail expansion, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform rail temperature, constant expansion coefficient and no axial restraint; temperature gradients are omitted. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior. Explain which evidence in rail temperature and endpoint displacement distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 全約束熱應力~Fully restrained thermal stress
units.title: 全約束熱應力~Fully restrained thermal stress
units.mechanism: 完全約束下軸向熱應變轉成應力。本模型把 E 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 66.4125 MPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。線彈性桿完全軸向約束；結果為應力大小，升溫為壓縮、降溫為拉伸。使用軌溫與可追溯應變作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；中性溫度估錯會讓應力估計整體偏移，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Full axial restraint converts thermal strain into stress. In this model, E is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 66.4125 MPa. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. A fully axially restrained elastic bar; the result is stress magnitude, compressive for heating and tensile for cooling. Use rail temperature and traceable strain as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Incorrect neutral temperature shifts the full stress estimate; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

units.verify: 本單元以軌溫與可追溯應變區分模型與觀察，先用合成約束力、截面面積、補償應變與軌溫時間序列建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「全約束熱應力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use rail temperature and traceable strain to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. units.title: 熱軸力換算~Thermal axial-force conversion
units.mechanism: 軸力等於平均應力乘有效斷面，左右兩軌須分別核對。本模型把 sigma 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 501.6 kN。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。應力沿有效斷面均勻；只算單根鋼軌的軸力。使用斷面損耗與軸向應變作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；磨耗斷面仍沿用新軌面積會誤算軸力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Axial force equals mean stress times effective area, with each rail checked separately. In this model, sigma is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 501.6 kN. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Stress is uniform over the effective section; force is for one rail only. Use section loss and axial strain as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Using new-rail area for worn rail miscalculates force; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Increasing only sigma with a ten-percent increase gives y=501.6 kN. Boundary: Stress is uniform over the effective section; force is for one rail only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

units.anchor: 軌溫量測誤差~Rail-temperature error propagation
units.title: 軌溫量測誤差~Rail-temperature error propagation
units.mechanism: 溫度誤差經彈性係數直接傳到熱應力估計。本模型把 E 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 5.313 MPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。只傳播軌溫誤差；彈性係數、熱膨脹係數及約束皆視為已知。使用兩種接觸式溫度量測作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；單側日照造成的溫差會讓表面溫度失去代表性，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Temperature error propagates through stiffness into thermal-stress estimation. In this model, E is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 5.313 MPa. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Only rail-temperature error is propagated; modulus, expansion coefficient and restraint are treated as known. Use two contact-temperature measurements as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. One-sided sunshine makes a surface temperature unrepresentative; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=210 GPa, alpha=0.0000115 1/K, uT=2 K；y=E*1000*alpha*uT=4.83 MPa。只把 E 增加百分之十，y=5.313 MPa。模型邊界：只傳播軌溫誤差；彈性係數、熱膨脹係數及約束皆視為已知；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: E=210 GPa, alpha=0.0000115 1/K, uT=2 K; y=E*1000*alpha*uT=4.83 MPa. Increasing only E with a ten-percent increase gives y=5.313 MPa. Boundary: Only rail-temperature error is propagated; modulus, expansion coefficient and restraint are treated as known; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以兩種接觸式溫度量測區分模型與觀察，先用同步雙溫度計、溫度校準紀錄及合成應力估計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「軌溫量測誤差」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use two contact-temperature measurements to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using paired synchronous thermometers, calibration records and synthetic stress estimates, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. units.anchor: 彈性釋放位移~Elastic release displacement
units.title: 彈性釋放位移~Elastic release displacement
units.mechanism: 軸向彈性位移由軸力、長度與軸向剛度共同決定。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 10.3383 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻線彈性桿及固定面積；位移不含支承滑移、塑性或裂縫。使用模型載入卸載位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；支承滑移會使量到的位移不再全是彈性伸長，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Axial elastic movement depends on force, length and axial rigidity. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 10.3383 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. A uniform elastic bar with constant area; displacement excludes support slip, plasticity and cracking. Use loading-unloading movement in the model as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Support slip means measured movement is not wholly elastic; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=300 kN, L=50 m, E=210 GPa, A=7600 mm2；y=F*1000*L/(E*1e9*A*1e-6)*1000=9.3985 mm。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=10.3383 mm。模型邊界：均勻線彈性桿及固定面積；位移不含支承滑移、塑性或裂縫；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=300 kN, L=50 m, E=210 GPa, A=7600 mm2; y=F*1000*L/(E*1e9*A*1e-6)*1000=9.3985 mm. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=10.3383 mm. Boundary: A uniform elastic bar with constant area; displacement excludes support slip, plasticity and cracking; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以模型載入卸載位移區分模型與觀察，先用低載模型力計、兩端相對位移及卸載回復曲線建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「彈性釋放位移」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use loading-unloading movement in the model to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-load model force gauge, relative endpoint displacement and unloading recovery, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Elastic release displacement. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 支承滑移會使量到的位移不再全是彈性伸長。這個失效與「彈性釋放位移」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查模型載入卸載位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Support slip means measured movement is not wholly elastic. This failure and a measurement bias in Elastic release displacement can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check loading-unloading movement in the model rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支承滑移會使量到的位移不再全是彈性伸長~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Support slip means measured movement is not wholly elastic.
units.practice: 重算「彈性釋放位移」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出均勻線彈性桿及固定面積；位移不含支承滑移、塑性或裂縫如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由支承滑移會使量到的位移不再全是彈性伸長造成偏離的合成觀察，以模型載入卸載位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Elastic release displacement, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: A uniform elastic bar with constant area; displacement excludes support slip, plasticity and cracking. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Support slip means measured movement is not wholly elastic. Explain which evidence in loading-unloading movement in the model distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 軌斷缺口量級~Broken-rail gap scale
units.title: 軌斷缺口量級~Broken-rail gap scale
units.mechanism: 釋放長度與溫差共同決定簡化缺口量級。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 15.18 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。長度是缺口兩側的總等效釋放長度；忽略分布摩擦與斷裂動態。使用缺口附近位移剖面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只以缺口大小推算整條線軌應力並不唯一，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Released length and temperature difference jointly determine a reduced gap scale. In this model, alpha is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 15.18 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Length is the total effective released length on both sides of a gap; distributed friction and fracture dynamics are omitted. Use displacement profile near a gap as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A gap size does not uniquely determine stress along an entire line; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=40 m, dT=30 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=13.8 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=15.18 mm。模型邊界：長度是缺口兩側的總等效釋放長度；忽略分布摩擦與斷裂動態；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=40 m, dT=30 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=13.8 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=15.18 mm. Boundary: Length is the total effective released length on both sides of a gap; distributed friction and fracture dynamics are omitted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以缺口附近位移剖面區分模型與觀察，先用合成缺口位移剖面、溫差及明列的兩側有效長度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「軌斷缺口量級」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use displacement profile near a gap to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic gap-displacement profile, temperature difference and declared effective lengths on both sides, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Broken-rail gap scale. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 只以缺口大小推算整條線軌應力並不唯一。這個失效與「軌斷缺口量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查缺口附近位移剖面，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~A gap size does not uniquely determine stress along an entire line. This failure and a measurement bias in Broken-rail gap scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check displacement profile near a gap rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只以缺口大小推算整條線軌應力並不唯一~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A gap size does not uniquely determine stress along an entire line.
units.practice: 重算「軌斷缺口量級」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出長度是缺口兩側的總等效釋放長度；忽略分布摩擦與斷裂動態如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只以缺口大小推算整條線軌應力並不唯一造成偏離的合成觀察，以缺口附近位移剖面說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Broken-rail gap scale, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Length is the total effective released length on both sides of a gap; distributed friction and fracture dynamics are omitted. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A gap size does not uniquely determine stress along an entire line. Explain which evidence in displacement profile near a gap distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

timeline.event: 美國鐵路管理局發布連續焊接鋼軌規則修訂。~FRA published its continuous welded rail final rule amendment.
歐盟公布整合基礎設施互通規範第一二九九號法規。~The EU issued Regulation 1299/2014 for the infrastructure interoperability specification.
